message.content:
```bash
for f in *.jpeg; do mv "$f" "${f%.jpeg}.jpg"; done
```

If your system has `rename` installed (common on Linux), this also works:

```bash
rename .jpeg .jpg *.jpeg
```

A couple of notes:
- The `for` loop version is the safest bet — it works everywhere and quotes the filenames, so files with spaces in their names are handled correctly.
- If you want a dry run first to preview the renames, add an `echo`: `for f in *.jpeg; do echo mv "$f" "${f%.jpeg}.jpg"; done`
